slacs_prime.description: SLACS (Bolton et al. 2008) lenses graded "Gold" by Etherington et al. 2022 (MNRAS 517, 3275), with marked image positions and no morphology difficulty flagged by eye. The working sample and the default --sample. Split from slacs_gold on 2026-10-29: Gold minus the lenses with deliberately empty positions (-> slacs_sparse), minus those judged by eye to have potentially difficult morphology such as a source overlapping the lens centre (-> slacs_complex), minus late-type (-> slacs_late) and SWELLS (-> swells) deflectors.

slacs_complex.description: SLACS lenses with marked image positions whose morphology was judged by eye (2026-10-29) to be potentially difficult, e.g. a source overlapping the lens centre: Gold lenses J0008-0004, J1218+0830, J1420+6019. Also the non-Gold SLACS lenses (Bolton et al. 2008 Table 4, E-S-A) that have marked positions and ACS F814W plus F555W or F606W: J1153+4612. Split from slacs_gold/slacs_other on 2026-10-29.

slacs_sparse.description: The remaining early-type SLACS lenses (Bolton et al. 2008 Table 4 class E-S-A or E-S-A*: definite lens, single early-type deflector). Gold lenses whose positions file is deliberately empty (J0157-0056, J0912+0029, J0936+0913, J1142+1001, J1143-0144, J1213+6708, J1402+6321, J2300+0022), and the non-Gold lenses without both marked positions and F814W plus an optical band (mostly WFPC2 F606W only). Also the 12 early-type (E, S0, E/S0) Auger et al. 2009 grade-A lenses added 2026-10-29: five Bolton grade-B lenses Auger promoted (J0819+4534, J1029+6115, J1330-0148, J1614+4522, J2347-0005) and seven of Auger's new WFPC2 targets (J1306+0600, J1313+4615, J1318-0313, J1644+2625, J1709+2324, J1719+2939, J2343-0030). Three (J0109+1500, J0405-0455, J1259+6134) have no usable HST imaging. Every non-Gold lens resolves on MAST under its plain SDSS<LENS> name, so a no-data result is a real absence. Split from slacs_gold/slacs_other on 2026-10-29.

slacs_late.description: SLACS lenses whose deflector is late-type and which are not SWELLS lenses: J1432+6317 (Bolton et al. 2008 Table 4 morphology L, Sa and later) and J1250-0135 (Bolton U-S-A*, Table 6: 'complicated by spiral structure and asymmetric bulge'; Auger et al. 2009 morph S0/SA; added 2026-10-29). Created 2026-10-29.

J1250-0135.note: Bolton 2008 U-S-A*; Table 6: complicated by spiral structure and asymmetric bulge in the foreground galaxy. Auger morph S0/SA. WFPC2 F606W only (GO-10798).

slacs_multi.description: SLACS lenses with more than one deflector galaxy (group-scale or multi-galaxy): the Bolton et al. 2008 Table 4 grade-A lenses of class E-M-A* (early-type, multiple foreground galaxies, definite lens), which the original E/L-S-A selection excluded. J0808+4706 (Bolton Table 6: 'nearby companion prevents simple SIE modeling'; ACS F814W GO-10886, WFPC2 F606W and WFC3/IR F160W GO-11202) and J1718+6424 ('double foreground galaxy'; WFPC2 F606W GO-10798 only). The third, J1618+4353 ('double foreground galaxy'), has only the 420 s SNAP F814W/F435W (GO-10174), below BLOCK_EXPTIME, so it is not in the roster. Also two Auger et al. 2009 grade-A lenses with companions: J1436+3640 (Auger morph E*, 'at least one close companion galaxy') and J1319+1504 (Auger: needs special subtraction for nearby galaxies); both WFPC2 F606W from GO-10886 and GO-11202 (split by program), plus WFPC2 F814W (J1319) or WFC3/IR F160W (J1436). Created 2026-10-29.

swells.description: SWELLS lenses (Treu et al. 2011; Brewer et al. 2012): high-inclination disk deflectors, lenticular to late-type spiral. Today only the six that SLACS also found and that were already reduced here: J0841+3824, J1029+0420, J1032+5322 (Etherington Gold), J0955+0101, J1251-0208, J2141-0001. Bolton et al. 2008 classes all but J1029+0420 as late-type. J1103+5322 (Bolton U-S-A, excluded by the original class rule) and J1313+0506 (Bolton L-S-B, promoted to grade A by Auger et al. 2009) were added 2026-10-29. The SWELLS-only grade-A lenses (GO-11978 WFPC2, GO-12292 ACS) are not yet reduced. Created 2026-10-29.

J1103+5322.note: Bolton 2008 U-S-A; SWELLS grade A. Auger morph S0/SA.

J1313+0506.note: Bolton 2008 L-S-B, promoted to Auger et al. 2009 (SLACS IX) grade A (spectroscopically confirmed; no Auger lens model); SWELLS grade A. Auger morph S.

gallery.description: BELLS GALLERY (HST proposals 14189, 16734), WFC3/UVIS multi-band (F438W, F606W, F814W; the F225W/F275W products were found unusable for lens science and deleted 2026-09-29). Restricted to Shu et al. 2016 Table 1 classification E-S-A (early-type, single lens, clear multiple imaging) — L-S-X, E-M-A, E-S-X, and E-S-M systems excluded. mast_target holds each lens's full SDSS coordinate designation, the MAST target name for this sample (see 'Non-standard MAST target names' in AGENTS.md). Reduced with drizzle_wfc3_uvis.py.

bells.description: BELLS (Brownstein et al. 2012), HST GO-12209, ACS/WFC F814W (~2200-2400 s per lens). Restricted to Brownstein et al. 2012 Table 3 classification E-S-A or L-S-A (early- or late-type, single lens, clear multiple imaging; 21 + 3), the same rule as the non-Gold SLACS lenses (originally the slacs_other sample). J1522+2910 (E-M-A) and all grade B/C/X systems excluded. Disjoint from gallery by construction (BELLS sources are [OII]/Hb/[OIII] emitters at z_s < 1.5). MAST target names are the short SDSS<LENS> form, so no mast_target overrides. Reduced, masked and positions marked (2026-10-22). J1337+3620 was REMOVED 2026-10-14: a multi-deflector system -- a companion 5.24" away (SDSS z_phot 0.59+/-0.10 vs z_lens 0.564), with 35-50% of the deflector's light, would need its own mass component. J1349+3612 was REMOVED 2026-10-14: a multi-deflector system -- a same-redshift companion 3.9" away (DESI z=0.4412 vs z_lens 0.4396, dv~330 km/s), ~80% of the deflector's light; Tan+2024 fits external shear 0.17. J1542+1629 was REMOVED 2026-10-22: its contaminant mask (the masked neighbouring galaxy) reaches in to 1.08", past theta_E = 1.04", so the mask cuts into the Einstein-ring annulus.

sl2s_dinos_a.description: SL2S lenses with deep WFC3/UVIS F475X from GO-17130 (Project Dinos II, Sheu+2025) PLUS a second band: WFPC2 F606W (GO-11289, lens on WF3) or ACS F814W (GO-10876). F475X is restricted to GO-17130 (proposals quirk). Roster agreed 2026-10-04; see AGENTS.md *SL2S samples*. Reduced, masked and positions marked (2026-10-24).

sl2s_dinos_x.description: SL2S lenses whose only deep band is WFC3/UVIS F475X from GO-17130 (Project Dinos II, Sheu+2025). J0233-0438 (GO-17130, not a Dinos II lens) was REMOVED 2026-10-14: both F475X visits failed (EXPFLAG TDF-DOWN AT EXPSTART, blank sky at the lens) -- see AGENTS.md *SL2S samples*. J0848-0351 was REMOVED 2026-10-24: not a real grade-A lens. Its SL2S III grade A (Table 6, HST=N) came from CFHT imaging plus the source redshift, before any HST data; the GO-17130 F475X shows a single arc on one side and no counter-image (as in Dinos II Fig. A2, whose theta_E 0.93+/-0.04" and q=0.43 are among the weakest constraints in the sample), so it fails SL2S III's own HST grade-A test of a visible multiple-image pair. J0219-0829, J0849-0412 and J2203+0205 also keep the GO-11588 snapshot F600LP. F475X is restricted to GO-17130. Roster agreed 2026-10-04; see AGENTS.md *SL2S samples*. Reduced, masked and positions marked (2026-10-24).

sl2s_snap.description: SL2S grade-A lenses (Sonnenfeld+2013 Table 6) whose only HST data is the GO-11588 WFC3/UVIS snapshot: F475X + F600LP, 2x360 s each (passes the 500 s gate with a low-exptime warning). J1423+5722 was REMOVED 2026-10-24: no demonstrated multiple imaging. Its only lensed feature is one arc at ~2.8" (2.1 theta_E) with no counter-image in either band; SL2S III gives it no per-lens note, and its model needs a mass axis ratio of 0.32 against a light axis ratio of ~0.85, a 31.7 mag source, and has no lens redshift. Under that model the arc's knots are singly imaged. Roster agreed 2026-10-04; see AGENTS.md *SL2S samples*. Reduced, masked and positions marked (2026-10-24).
